sources.quote: To be honest, I think the team's performance can definitely affect the neighborhood's mood, but I haven't really seen that play out yet this season. I mean, we're still finding our rhythm, and I'm confident we'll tighten up and be ready for the real deal.

sources.name: Austin Reaves
sources.quote: Honestly, I think fans are getting a little frustrated with the team's performance so far. I mean, we're still finding our footing, but it's hard not to worry when we're not seeing the wins. I trust that we'll get it together, we just need to keep working and supporting each other.

approvedQuotes.text: To be honest, I think the team's performance can definitely affect the neighborhood's mood, but I haven't really seen that play out yet this season. I mean, we're still finding our rhythm, and I'm confident we'll tighten up and be ready for the real deal.

Honestly, I think fans are getting a little frustrated with the team's performance so far. I mean, we're still finding our footing, but it's hard not to worry when we're not seeing the wins. I trust that we'll get it together, we just need to keep working and supporting each other.
